ResourceHeader.ResourceName: Hinode SOT-FG Level 0 Stokes I and V with Dopplergram FITS Data (FGIVDG)

RevisionEvent.Note: Initial metadata creation and publication. SY

ResourceHeader.Description: The Hinode Solar Optical Telescope Filtergraph (SOT-FG) Level 0 FGIVDG FITS data product contains uncalibrated Stokes I, Dopplergram, and Stokes V images acquired by the Narrowband Filter Imager (NFI; FITS INSTRUME='SOT/NB') in the shuttered observing mode. The product is identified by DataCode FGIVDG and OBS_TYPE='FG shuttered IV+DG', distinguishing it from the FGIV Stokes I and V product. In the inspected files, the FITS Primary HDU contains a three-dimensional image array with three two-dimensional planes in the order Stokes I, Dopplergram (DG), and Stokes V, consistent with the SolarSoft FG_IMAGE_TYPE definition for GEN_ID=18. The Dopplergram is generated onboard, and the Level 0 images have not undergone ground-based scientific calibration. Spatial dimensions and angular pixel scales vary with observing settings, including subframing and binning; the nominal unbinned NFI scale is approximately 0.08 arcsec per pixel. The observing passband is identified by the FITS header keyword WAVE; the inspected FGIVDG samples use Na I 589.6 nm. The FITS headers also describe exposure and image sampling.

Parameter.Name: Stokes I, Dopplergram, and Stokes V Images
Parameter.Description: Three-dimensional Level 0 SOT-FG NFI shuttered image data stored in the FITS Primary HDU. The first two array dimensions represent spatial image coordinates; in the inspected files, the third dimension contains three image planes in the order Stokes I, Dopplergram (DG), and Stokes V, as identified for GEN_ID=18 by the SolarSoft FG_IMAGE_TYPE routine. The Dopplergram is generated onboard, and the Level 0 data have not undergone ground-based scientific calibration. The observing passband is identified by the FITS header keyword WAVE; the inspected samples use the Na I 589.6 nm spectral line. The calibration and numerical scaling required to interpret the DG values as line-of-sight velocity are not established for this Level 0 product.
